PublicProfile.title: PublicProfile
PublicProfile.description: Public profile accessible to all users on the Thikana platform.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the user.

displayName.description: Public display name of the user.

photoURL.description: URL to user's public profile picture.

role.description: Role of the user in Thikana.

isVerified.description: Verification badge status for trust and safety.

PrivateUser.title: PrivateUser
PrivateUser.description: Confidential PII and identity verification records isolated from public access.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID matching the document ID.

nidNumber.description: Government National ID (NID) or smart card number.

hiddenAddress.description: Full confidential physical or permanent address.

Property.title: Property
Property.description: Rental property listing posted by a landlord or property manager.

propertyId.description: Unique identifier for the property listing.

rentAmount.description: Monthly rental price in local currency.

amenities.description: List of amenities (e.g., parking, elevator, generator, gas).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp of when the listing was published.

/publicProfiles/{uid}.description: Public user profiles readable by everyone, writable only by the account owner.

/privateUsers/{uid}.description: Private user identity records strictly readable and writable only by the authenticated owner.

/properties/{propertyId}.description: Public property listings readable by everyone, writable only by the listing landlord.
